roadmap.title: Early leaves and first prestige
roadmap.description: Blow leaves, buy the Leaf Blower, unlock Gold Leaves and the Leaf Portal, prestige, then reach Platinum, Bismuth, Cosmic and Void Leaves.

roadmap.title: Flasks
roadmap.description: Use converters to turn Void Leaves into each flask type up to Black Flasks.

roadmap.title: First Big Leaf Crunch
roadmap.description: Buy the BLC portal in the Black Flask shop and crunch.

roadmap.title: Unique leaves
roadmap.description: Earn 20m BLC coins, open the needed areas, then blow each unique leaf off screen with the right tool and leaf amount.

achievements.description: Where do all the leaves come from?
achievements.summary: Enter the Leaf Portal for the first time.

guide.context: The portal suggests 20+ coins, but @mechanic{Leaf Combo} gives far more if you wait.

steps.text: Buy @item{Unlock Leaf Portal} in the @mechanic{Gold Shop}.
Blow leaves and buy upgrades until you have several hundred coins ready to claim, then enter the @mechanic{Leaf Portal}.

achievements.description: SO. MANY. LEAVES.
achievements.summary: Enter the Big Leaf Crunch portal for the first time.

guide.context: Crunching wipes your leaves, flasks and prestige coins. You keep BLC coins, areas, gems and unique leaves.

steps.text: Buy the BLC portal in the @mechanic{Black Flask} shop.
Enter the red @mechanic{Big Leaf Crunch} portal.

achievements.description: Blowing leaves is quite fun with a leaf blower!
achievements.summary: Buy the Leaf Blower tool.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Tool Shop} and buy the tool shown as a question mark, the @item{Leaf Blower}.

achievements.description: You have blown away 1.000 leaves. Neat.
achievements.summary: Blow away 1,000 leaves in total.

steps.text: Blow leaves off the screen until you reach 1,000 in total.

achievements.description: You have blown away 1 million leaves. Wow.
achievements.summary: Blow away 1 million leaves in total.

steps.text: Keep blowing leaves off the screen until you reach 1 million in total.

achievements.description: Make science with leaves.
achievements.summary: Get Red Flasks.

steps.text: Buy @item{Unlock Converters} in the coins shop.
Reach 10.14k Void Leaves to open the red flask shop.
Start the Red Flask converter.

achievements.description: Make more science with leaves.
achievements.summary: Get Green Flasks.

steps.text: Collect 930 Red Flasks to open the Green flask shop.
Start the Green Flask converter.

achievements.description: You have researched RGB science.
achievements.summary: Get Blue Flasks.

steps.text: Collect 930 Green Flasks to open the Blue flask shop.
Start the Blue Flask converter.

achievements.description: They look SO cool.
achievements.summary: Get Magenta Flasks.

steps.text: Collect 930 Blue Flasks to open the Magenta flask shop.
Start the Magenta Flask converter.

achievements.description: Where do you store all the flasks?
achievements.summary: Get Orange Flasks.

steps.text: Collect 930 Magenta Flasks to open the Orange flask shop.
Start the Orange Flask converter.

achievements.description: Nothing escapes from black flasks except...
achievements.summary: Get Black Flasks.

guide.context: The black flask shop also sells the BLC portal used for the Big Leaf Crunch.

steps.text: Collect 930 Orange Flasks to open the black flask shop.
Start the Black Flask converter.

achievements.description: Gold leaves? They must be worth something.
achievements.summary: Blow Gold Leaves off the screen.

steps.text: Buy @item{Gold Leaves} in the leaf shop.
Blow a gold leaf off the screen.

achievements.description: Platinum leaves? What kind of tree drops platinum leaves?
achievements.summary: Blow Platinum Leaves off the screen.

steps.text: Buy @item{Unlock Areas} in the coins shop for 20 coins.
Buy @item{Platinum Leaves} in the @mechanic{Gold Shop}.
Open the areas menu and go to the @loc{Neighbors' Garden}.
Blow a platinum leaf off the screen.

achievements.description: Bismuth leaves? HAVE YOU EVER SEEN ANY BISMUTH LEAVES?!
achievements.summary: Blow Bismuth Leaves off the screen.

steps.text: Buy everything in the platinum shop to unlock bismuth.
Start the platinum-to-bismuth converter, then blow bismuth leaves off the screen.

achievements.description: Cosmic leaves? What is this, a space game?
achievements.summary: Blow Cosmic Leaves off the screen.

steps.text: Buy everything in the bismuth shop.
Start the bismuth-to-cosmic converter, then blow cosmic leaves off the screen.

achievements.description: Void leaves? Yeah, right.
achievements.summary: Blow Void Leaves off the screen.

steps.text: Buy everything in the cosmic shop and open @loc{THE VOID} from the areas menu.
Blow void leaves off the screen.

achievements.description: Help your neighbor to pick up some platinum leaves.
achievements.summary: Blow the Crystal Leaf off the screen in the Neighbors' Garden with your hands while holding 1c Platinum Leaves.

guide.context: You need 20m BLC coins before unique leaves unlock. The areas menu is already open by then (@item{Unlock Areas} costs 20 coins in the coins shop).

steps.text: Equip @item{Your Hands} and go to the @loc{Neighbors' Garden}.
Hold at least 1c (1e21) Platinum Leaves.
Blow the Crystal Leaf off the screen.

achievements.description: Lazers can be dangerous in voids.
achievements.summary: Blow the Fire Leaf off the screen in THE VOID with the Lazer while holding 1C Void Leaves.

guide.context: You need 20m BLC coins before unique leaves unlock. The areas menu is already open by then (@item{Unlock Areas} costs 20 coins in the coins shop).

steps.text: Open @loc{THE VOID} from the areas menu for about 2.5k coins, then equip the @item{Lazer} and go there.
Hold at least 1C (1e24) Void Leaves.
Blow the Fire Leaf off the screen.

achievements.description: Did you know can blow away Ghosts in Space with a fish?
achievements.summary: Blow the Ghost Leaf off the screen in Space with the Blowfish while holding 1d Cosmic Leaves.

guide.context: You need 20m BLC coins before unique leaves unlock. The areas menu is already open by then (@item{Unlock Areas} costs 20 coins in the coins shop).

steps.text: Open @loc{Space} from the areas menu for 500 coins, then equip the @item{Blowfish} and go there.
Hold at least 1d (1e27) Cosmic Leaves.
Blow the Ghost Leaf off the screen.

achievements.description: A rake can be used as a cane in the mountains.
achievements.summary: Blow the Glitter Leaf off the screen at the Mountain with a rake while holding 1D Bismuth Leaves.

guide.context: You need 20m BLC coins before unique leaves unlock. The areas menu is already open by then (@item{Unlock Areas} costs 20 coins in the coins shop).

steps.text: Open the @loc{Mountain} from the areas menu for 10 coins, then equip any @item{Rake} and go there.
Hold at least 1D (1e30) Bismuth Leaves.
Blow the Glitter Leaf off the screen.

achievements.description: Home is where your Leaf Blower is.
achievements.summary: Blow the Heart Leaf off the screen in the Home Garden with the Leaf Blower while holding 100e Gold Leaves.

guide.context: You need 20m BLC coins before unique leaves unlock.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Leaf Blower} and go to the @loc{Home Garden}.
Hold at least 100e (1e35) Gold Leaves. The suffix e means 1e33, so this is 100 times that.
Blow the Heart Leaf off the screen.

achievements.description: A physical device may help you to reach the sky.
achievements.summary: Blow the Rainbow Leaf off the screen at the Celestial Plane with the Rocket Engine while holding 100k Celestial Leaves.

guide.context: You need 20m BLC coins before unique leaves unlock. The areas menu is already open by then (@item{Unlock Areas} costs 20 coins in the coins shop).

steps.text: Open the @loc{Celestial Plane} for 1m BLC coins, then equip the @item{Rocket Engine} and go there.
Hold at least 100k (1e5) Celestial Leaves.
Blow the Rainbow Leaf off the screen.

achievements.summary: Blow the Robot Leaf off the screen in the Abyss with the Graphics Card while holding 1m Exotic Leaves.

guide.context: You need 20m BLC coins before unique leaves unlock. The areas menu is already open by then (@item{Unlock Areas} costs 20 coins in the coins shop).

steps.text: Open the @loc{Abyss} for 25k Strange Flasks, then equip the @item{Graphics Card} and go there.
Buy @item{Exotic Leaves} in the Strange Flask shop, then hold at least 1m (1e6) of them.
Blow the Robot Leaf off the screen.

achievements.description: Playing for the high one, dancing with the fire.
achievements.summary: Blow the Bone Leaf off the screen in the Volcano with the Ace of Spades while holding 100m Lava Leaves.

guide.context: You need 20m BLC coins before unique leaves unlock. The areas menu is already open by then (@item{Unlock Areas} costs 20 coins in the coins shop).

steps.text: Open the @loc{Volcano} for 500m BLC coins. It hurts you, so buy defense upgrades first.
Equip the @item{Ace of Spades} and go there.
Hold at least 100m (1e8) Lava Leaves, then blow the Bone Leaf off the screen.
